en: Proof of Kingship
note: Monster skill (JOB_MONS_KING_of_KING): immune to instant death while HP >= half. Also JOB_LIST c4 copy.

en: Regeneration
note: Monster skill (JOB_MONS_REVIVAL): chance to cure ailments that do not heal naturally. Also JOB_LIST c4 copy.

en: Can survive lethal damage, but only once.
Pull effects no longer work on the user.
note: [JP] = Pull (ebt: 'Withstood the pull').

en: Stops barriers from activating. The chance rises when several members have it.
Strengthens elemental spells.
Ignores the target's spell resistance.
Using a Tent gives the same effect as staying at the inn.
Healing spells you cast always restore at least half of max HP.
note: Whose max HP is not stated (almost certainly the target's); left unstated.

en: Has a chance to inflict the status ailment "Fear" on an enemy.
note: [JP] = status ailment (HELP_TEXT precedent); [JP] = Fear (ebt).

en: If the thief can't carry a stolen item, an ally carries it instead.
Treasure chests appear even after random encounters.
Has a chance to block an enemy's end-of-turn natural healing and the like.
When same-grade ores above a set grade explode in alchemy, something special happens.
note: Shared by [JP]/[JP]/[JP]. [JP] = grade (HELP_TEXT, wmap).

en: Cooks a meal.
Can attack by throwing corpses.
When hit by a spell, has a chance to convert it into MP.
Adds curse info to item details. Ore grades can also be checked on the spot.
Sends items that can't be carried to the Alchemy Storage.
note: Alchemy Storage = glossary.

en: Mimics an enemy's action.
Raises allies' attack power, only for the turn it is used.
Deals non-elemental damage to one enemy.
Deals more damage while poisoned.
Has a chance to inflict Fear on all enemies.
Restores HP when walking during the day in clear weather.
At turn's end, sings to heal all allies. Lasts a while; stacking songs raises the power.
At turn's end, sings to damage enemies. Lasts a while; stacking songs raises the power.
note: [JP] number not specified; plural 'enemies' (likely all).

en: Sings a song that reduces damage. Lasts a while; stacking songs raises the power.
Sings a song that cures status ailments. Lasts a while; stacking songs raises the power.
A Fortune Slip changes the EXP and money gained after battle.
note: [JP] = Fortune Slip (slice_10).

en: Forms a pact with a monster and invites it to the tavern.
Fuses contracted monsters and summons them. Allies can't act during the summon.
Lowers the target's level.
Turns the user to ash to fully heal all allies. Once per battle only.
Devotes every action to defense, nullifying enemy attacks.
If battle opens with an enemy ambush, allies deal more damage from the next turn on.
note: [JP] read as damage DEALT by allies (skill name [JP] = signal of counterattack).

en: Deals more damage at night.
note: [JP] read as damage dealt (nocturnal attacker).

en: Can attack without taking a Swallow Return counter.
note: UNCERTAIN: [JP] skill name (JOB_EX:57:2, slice_29) not yet fixed; 'Swallow Return' assumed. Align with slice_29 / [JP] = Swallow Slayer.

en: Summons a clone of the user into the summon slot.
note: [JP] = summon slot (wmap: summoned-monster slot).

en: The fewer members in the party, the higher the defense.
The closer HP is to max, the higher the attack power.
The closer HP is to its minimum, the higher the attack power.
Attack is always raised, but HP drops at turn end. Can't be a Maid Recover target.
note: Maid Recover = ebt/HELP_TEXT.

en: Breath attacks never lose power.
Healing spells can't be used in battle.
Damage dealt to adventurers is doubled.
Damage dealt to adventurers is tripled.
Damage dealt to adventurers is multiplied by 5.
Immune to instant death such as beheading while HP is at half or more.
note: [JP] = beheading (cf. Beheading Anklet).

en: Has a chance to cure status ailments that don't heal naturally.
Kills a summoned monster in one blow.
Svt. Bag
note: [JP] = Servant's Bag (HELP_TEXT), abbreviated to fit 8 bytes (JOB_LIST c3 camp list).

en: Song of Battle
note: Unused song (no JOB_EX entry); follows Song of Healing/Ruin/Warding/Hope pattern.

en: Song of Smiles
note: Unused song (no JOB_EX entry); same pattern.

en: Sever Summon
note: [JP] is a misspelling of [JP] (= Sever Summon, ebt slice_15); same English.

en: Bloodwed
note: [JP] 'blood wedding'; 8-byte limit (camp list c3) forces a coined compound. Unused (used=false).

en: Racial Skill
note: Group label in JOB_LIST c4 for Breath row; unused.

en: Ward of Creation
note: Legacy c4 name matching JOB_EX:66 [JP] (row offset +2); unused. Literal: protection of life-creation.

en: Excavation
note: JOB_LIST c4 (used) for JOB_EX:69 [JP]; standalone [JP]. Check against slice_29's name for [JP].

en: Way of Meddling
note: Legacy c4 name matching JOB_EX:70 [JP]; unused.

en: Dark Realm Torrent
note: [JP] = Dark Realm (glossary). Legacy c4 name matching JOB_EX:110 [JP]; unused. Exactly 18 bytes.
